item.title: Private Hospital Beds Officially Surpass Public Beds In Penang: Exco
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Penang now has more private hospital beds (2,853) than public hospital beds (2,130), says exco Daniel Gooi. Half of Malaysia's medical tourists go to Penang. He says some doctors at Sunway Medical Centre Penang previously worked at Seberang Jaya Hospital.
